Take whatever attribute you need at the time, you'll default to dex if you don't need anything, after 161 dex you should default to strength for more HP.

This is a level 95 tree. Takeout some hybrid nodes if you're lower lvl.

If you have projectile speed on your quiver, you should also take Feathered Fletching

Ascendancy order:
Projectile Proximity Specialisation(point blank) -> Endless Munitions -> Gathering Winds -> Mirage Deadeye

Weapon Set:
Follow the Weapon set I have above. Essentially you want all of your DPS skills on weapon set 1 and Freezing Mark on weapon set 2.
